items.title: Online Gaming License Application Form
items.description: Please correct the below issues on the Online Gaming License Application Form and resubmit the form.

items.title: Business and Corporate Information Form - Questions 8 and 9
items.description: Questions 8 and 9 have been left blank. Question 11.1 indicates that the company will be funded through shareholder loans. Please clarify as to where the company will be receiving the funds from the loan.

items.title: Business Plan
items.description: The business plan must include the company management structure showing key management roles and reporting lines and a detailed 3-year forecast.

items.title: goAML Registration
items.description: Please note that the proof of goAML registration is missing. Kindly submit a screenshot of the admin page when logged in to the goAML portal. To do this, log in to the goAML portal, click Admin, select Active Organizations and take a screenshot of the page. Please upload the screenshot in the Extra Documentation section.

items.title: Source of Funds of Business
items.description: Please submit a certified copy of the loan agreement which outlines the key terms, including the funding, and any interest on the loan and the repayment terms (if applicable). The loan agreement must be signed by all parties and certified as a true copy. Kindly upload it in the Source of Funding Section.

items.title: Gideon van Kessel - Personal History Disclosure Short Form
items.description: Please add the UBO Gideon Van Kessel to the portal and upload the Personal History Disclosure Short Form.

items.title: Gideon van Kessel - Criminal Record
items.description: Please submit the below documents in the base application QPA/2024/00514: A certified true copy of a criminal record for the state of Florida issued within the last six months. A certified true copy of an FBI Identity History Summary Check issued within the last six months. Note: A criminal record check must be provided for every jurisdiction where the person has resided for more than six months in the last two years. If the UBO has resided in jurisdictions other than the U.S. within the last two years, certified copies of criminal records (issued within the last six months) for those jurisdictions must also be provided.

items.title: Gideon van Kessel - Birth Certificate
items.description: Please submit the following in the base application QPA/2024/00514: A certified true copy of the original birth certificate in Dutch. An English translation of the birth certificate certified by the translator.

items.title: Gideon van Kessel - Proof of Address
items.description: Please submit an acceptable proof of address document in the base application QPA/2024/00514. The document must be a utility bill, landline phone bill, or internet/cable bill. Mobile phone bills are not accepted. The document must have been issued within the last six months and be certified as a true copy.

items.title: Gideon van Kessel - Source of Wealth
items.description: Please submit additional evidence of source of wealth in the base application QPA/2024/00514. All documents submitted must be recent and certified as a true copy.

items.title: Ronalyn Flores - Proof of Address
items.description: Please provide a certified copy of the proof of address document.

items.title: Vai Hui - Birth Certificate
items.description: Please submit an English translation of the birth certificate certified by the translator.

items.title: Vai Hui - Bank Reference Letter
items.description: Please provide a certified copy of the bank reference letter.

items.title: Mark Taylor - Personal History Disclosure SHORT Form
items.description: Please submit the current version of the Personal History Disclosure SHORT Form available on the CGA website.

items.title: Mark Taylor - Birth Certificate
items.description: Please provide a copy of the birth certificate that has been certified as a true copy by an independent and authorized certifier. The certification as a true copy must be no more than six months old. Please upload the document in the base application QPA/2024/00381.

items.title: Mark Taylor - Criminal Record Finland
items.description: Please submit a criminal record for Finland issued within the last six months and certified as a true copy. Please upload the document in the base application QPA/2024/00381.

items.title: Mark Taylor - Proof of Address
items.description: The documents submitted for proof of address (bank statement and insurance statement) cannot be accepted. Please upload an accepted proof of address document (utility bill, landline phone bill, cable/internet bill) issued within the last six months and certified as a true copy. Please upload the document in the base application QPA/2024/00381.

items.title: Mark Taylor - Curriculum Vitae (CV)
items.description: Please upload a copy of Mark Taylor's Curriculum Vitae (CV) in English. Please upload the document in the base application QPA/2024/00381 in the Letter of Engagement section.
